meta_description:
13K likes, 67 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "This lake holds a fifth of the world’s fresh water, and every winter it freezes into something unreal ❄️ ⁠
⁠
Lake Baikal in Siberia is the oldest and deepest lake on Earth, and from late February its ice turns crystal clear. Small guided groups cross a landscape that feels almost cosmic: ice so smooth it mirrors the sky, cliffs coated in frozen splashes, and the famous methane bubbles trapped deep inside.⁠
⁠
As the guides behind these photos say, Baikal’s ice is something you should see with your own eyes at least once in your life.⁠
⁠
Walking on a frozen lake is only safe with experienced local guides who know the ice and how conditions change, so never head out alone.⁠
⁠
By: @andrewk_travel".
